title: On a Class of Optimal Reinsurance Problems
summary: De Finetti's optimal reinsurance is a set of contracts, one for each risk in a portfolio, that caps the retained aggregate variance to a pre-specified level while minimizing total expected loss. The premiums are determined using the expected value principle, and the safety loading is allowed to vary with the risks. The original formulation assumed that the risks were independent and restricted contracts to quota shares on individual risks.
